task.title: Address PR #384 scoped mount review findings

events.content: Treat persisted scoped roots as the runtime-state boundary and sweep the catalog root only for legacy dead letters: Treat persisted scoped roots as the runtime-state boundary and sweep the catalog root only for legacy dead letters

raw.question: Treat persisted scoped roots as the runtime-state boundary and sweep the catalog root only for legacy dead letters
raw.chosen: Treat persisted scoped roots as the runtime-state boundary and sweep the catalog root only for legacy dead letters
raw.reasoning: Each scoped syncer owns child .relay state; aggregating the common root would double-count stale exact-layout state, while dead-letter compatibility must still discover pre-scoped root records

events.content: Ignore blank path candidates before normalization and apply fallback only when no valid candidates remain: Ignore blank path candidates before normalization and apply fallback only when no valid candidates remain

raw.question: Ignore blank path candidates before normalization and apply fallback only when no valid candidates remain
raw.chosen: Ignore blank path candidates before normalization and apply fallback only when no valid candidates remain
raw.reasoning: Relay intentionally treats / as a real full-workspace root, so blank/null display input must never become indistinguishable from an explicit root selection

events.content: All three review findings are addressed with behavioral tests: scoped allowlists cannot widen through blanks, runtime status aggregates sibling roots, and dead-letter list/refresh/retry/replay remain discoverable

retrospective.summary: Closed PR #384 review gaps: blank/null paths cannot widen a scoped allowlist, CLI status aggregates sibling runtime roots, and dead-letter list/refresh/retry/replay traverse persisted scoped roots
